title: openspec/owners.yaml
description: Git-native ownership map (multiplayer-collaboration ri-02, change ownership-map). Assigns owners, decision rights and acceptance rights to OpenSpec capabilities, roadmap items and repository paths, with a mandatory repository-default owner as the fail-closed fallback. Owners are human principal ids declared in the `humans:` block of the principal registry (agents.yaml); agents are never owners. Resolved by skills/ownership-runtime/scripts/owners.py, which performs the cross-file checks this schema cannot (owner is registered, owner is not an agent).

default_owner.description: Repository-default owner. Every subject with no matching assignment resolves to this principal (source: default_owner). Must be a registered human principal.

registry.description: Optional repo-relative path to the principal registry (agents.yaml). Confined to the repository: no leading `/`, no `..` segment, and the resolver rejects a value that resolves outside the repository root (design D3, D10). When omitted the resolver tries agent-coordinator/agents.yaml, then agents.yaml at the repository root. OWNERSHIP_REGISTRY_PATH overrides both and is not confined.

assignments.description: Explicit assignments by subject kind. Any kind may be omitted.

capabilities.description: Keyed by OpenSpec capability directory name (openspec/specs/<name>).

paths.description: Keyed by repo-relative glob pattern. Restricted to the syntax CODEOWNERS and the resolver interpret identically: `*`, `**`, `?`, optional leading `/`, optional trailing `/`. No `!` negation, no `[...]` classes, no whitespace (design D3, D8). The most specific matching rule wins (design D4).

PrincipalId.description: Human principal id: a key of the registry's `humans:` block. Shares the slug pattern and namespace with agent names.

PathPattern.description: Repo-relative glob using only `*`, `**`, `?`, letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `-` and `/`. Negation, character classes and whitespace are rejected so the resolver and GitHub CODEOWNERS agree on every match. `**` must be a whole path segment; the loader rejects an embedded `**` (design D3 matching table).

owners.description: Principals who own this subject. Ownership is decision rights plus acceptance rights (P2); it is not a claim on implementation labor.

decision_rights.description: Principals who decide questions the spec leaves open for this subject. Defaults to `owners`.

acceptance_rights.description: Principals who accept or reject results delivered against this subject. Defaults to `owners`.
